$comment: Registry of deterministic-fix functions. create-skill + determinize-skill consult this BEFORE writing AI for computable work. All functions obey CONTRACT.md (exit 0 confident / 10 abstain / 1 error).

extract_ticket_id.purpose: Ticket ID from a branch name or free text
extract_ticket_id.signature: extract_ticket_id <string> -> stdout id | exit 10 abstain | exit 1 error

detect_vcs_platform.purpose: Map a git remote URL to a VCS platform
detect_vcs_platform.signature: detect_vcs_platform <remote-url> -> stdout github|gitlab|bitbucket|azure | exit 10 abstain | exit 1 error

extract_repo_group.purpose: Group/subgroup path from a git remote URL (for scoped repo search)
extract_repo_group.signature: extract_repo_group <remote-url> -> stdout group/path | exit 10 abstain | exit 1 error

is_protected_branch.purpose: Predicate: is this a protected branch (don't commit/push directly)

count_commits.purpose: Count commits in a rev-range (git rev-list --count wrapper)
abstains_on: invalid range / not a repo (-> exit 1 -> AI)

score_to_severity.purpose: Bucket an integer 0-100 confidence score to a severity label
score_to_severity.note: ONLY the bucketing is deterministic; the score itself stays AI-produced (do NOT determinize the judgment).
